decisions.reason: A multi-model formwork profile line close to the core offer, given its own page through 2019, likely meets aspirations in a growing industry, and the expanding firm has slack to keep carrying it.

This magnetic formwork component was presented on its own page in both observed years, which suggests it performs satisfactorily and fits the core offer well.
